meta.title: B1: 3x calendar resets against 3x daily twins
meta.caption: Data: TradingView (via local export), FRED. Every 3x calendar fund is HYPOTHETICAL; the real UPRO and TQQQ are price-only overlays. Not investment advice.

SPX.banner: [SPX_TR] symbols: SP:SPX, SP:SPXTR; basis: constructed; published 1988-01-04 on (PUBLISHED (SP:SPXTR as exported)); before that price + Shiller's measured monthly dividend yield (mean 4.10%/yr over the pre-splice years) (MEASURED (Shiller monthly D/P; quarterly dividends interpolated to months by the source)); splice date 1988-01-04; days missing from the published series carried by the price move: ['1994-04-27']; stale published rows on non-trading days dropped: ['2001-09-11', '2001-09-12', '2001-09-13', '2001-09-14']; published rows after the price file's last date dropped: ['2026-11-03'] (top up the price file)

rate.source: FRED DFF (effective fed funds), lagged one row; TB3MS proxy where DFF is not yet published
rate.proxy_rule: TB3MS monthly average shifted forward one month (month t uses month t-1's average), then lagged one row

SPX.trigger_text: the AMEX:SPY price (daily low) from 1993-01-29, scaled to the SP:SPX price index before that

NDX.banner: [NDX_TR] symbols: NASDAQ:NDX, NASDAQ:XNDX; basis: constructed; published 2010-01-04 on (VERIFIED (NASDAQ:XNDX, anchor-checked)); 2006-11-08..2010-01-04 price + 0.73%/yr (MEASURED (level change of mis-dated XNDX block)); 1999-03-05..2006-11-08 price + QQQ's fiscal-year income yield (mean 0.35%/yr; MEASURED (QQQ gross income / average net assets by fiscal year; SEC 485BPOS financial highlights)); before 1999-03-05 price + 0.30%/yr (ASSUMED); splice date 2010-01-04; days missing from the published series carried by the price move: ['2012-10-31']

rate.source: FRED DFF (effective fed funds), lagged one row; TB3MS proxy where DFF is not yet published
rate.proxy_rule: TB3MS monthly average shifted forward one month (month t uses month t-1's average), then lagged one row

NDX.trigger_text: the NASDAQ:QQQ price (daily low) from 1999-03-10, scaled to the NASDAQ:NDX price index before that

banner: Inputs: 10 files; prices from <external>/library, rates from <external>/rates
SPX early-reset trigger: the AMEX:SPY price (daily low) from 1993-01-29, scaled to the SP:SPX price index before that; trigger basis 'etf'; drop 35% from the fund's base; fill mode 'level'.
SPX day counts: financing (reference rate and swap spread) ACT/360; expense ratio ACT/365 (calendar days between rows, so weekends and holidays accrue).
SPX reset dates: last NYSE session of the week / month / quarter from 1970-01-01 (calendar_letf/nyse.py, refuses data that lack it); before that the last row of the period.
NDX early-reset trigger: the NASDAQ:QQQ price (daily low) from 1999-03-10, scaled to the NASDAQ:NDX price index before that; trigger basis 'etf'; drop 35% from the fund's base; fill mode 'level'.
NDX day counts: financing (reference rate and swap spread) ACT/360; expense ratio ACT/365 (calendar days between rows, so weekends and holidays accrue).
NDX reset dates: last NYSE session of the week / month / quarter from 1970-01-01 (calendar_letf/nyse.py, refuses data that lack it); before that the last row of the period.
B1 trigger rules replace the 35% drop above: none none, scaled 23.33%, d20 20.00%, d25 25.00%, d30 30.00%, fixed35 35.00%.
Study end fixed at 2026-09-30; Monte Carlo seed 20261106.

cost_effect.rule: twice the filed spread against the filed spread, trigger scaled: CAGR drop and the move of the 10-year median gap
